001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007import java.math.BigInteger;
008
009@HistoryLogProps(
010    opCode = 61,
011    displayName = "Cannula Filled",
012    internalName = "LID_CANNULA_FILLED",
013    usedByTidepool = true
014)
015public class CannulaFilledHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
016
017    private float primeSize;
018    private long completionStatus;
019
020    public CannulaFilledHistoryLog() {}
021    public CannulaFilledHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, float primeSize, long completionStatus) {
022        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
023        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, primeSize, completionStatus);
024        this.primeSize = primeSize;
025        this.completionStatus = completionStatus;
026
027    }
028
029    public CannulaFilledHistoryLog(float primeSize, long completionStatus) {
030        this(0, 0, primeSize, completionStatus);
031    }
032
033    public int typeId() {
034        return 61;
035    }
036
037    /**
038     * <table border="1">
039     * <caption>Parsed fields for CannulaFilledHistoryLog:</caption>
040     * <tr><td><code>primeSize</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
041     * <tr><td><code>completionStatus</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
042     * </table>
043     */
044    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
045        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
046        this.cargo = raw;
047        parseBase(raw);
048        this.primeSize = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 10);
049        this.completionStatus = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
050
051    }
052
053    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, float primeSize, long completionStatus) {
054        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
055            new byte[]{61, 0},
056            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
057            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
058            Bytes.toFloat(primeSize),
059            Bytes.toUint32(completionStatus)));
060    }
061
062    /**
063     * @return the number of units used to prime the cannula
064     */
065    public float getPrimeSize() {
066        return primeSize;
067    }
068
069    public long getCompletionStatusRaw() {
070        return completionStatus;
071    }
072    public CompletionStatus getCompletionStatus() {
073        return CompletionStatus.fromId((int) completionStatus);
074    }
075
076    public enum CompletionStatus {
077        USER_ABORTED(0),
078        TERMINATED_BY_ALARM(1),
079        TERMINATED_BY_MALFUNCTION(2),
080        COMPLETED(3),
081
082        ;
083        private final int id;
084        CompletionStatus(int id) {
085            this.id = id;
086        }
087
088        static CompletionStatus fromId(int id) {
089            for (CompletionStatus r : values()) {
090                if (r.id == id) {
091                    return r;
092                }
093            }
094            return null;
095        }
096    }
097
098}
